posts.title: The Quest for Real Time
posts.description: Along my journey to create intelligent NPCs, I’m often asked what I’m trying to build. The best comparison I can offer, especially for those less versed in game AI, is Star Trek’s holodeck, a simulated world where characters respond to you as if they were real.
